scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten tiles are full frames, with readable GSD/presence captions and gold rectangle overlays only on the five target-present views.
At 0.5 cm/px the positive tile shows a clear dark tapered animal silhouette within the gold rectangle; the silhouette becomes smaller through the 1, 2, 3 and 4 cm/px columns.
The corresponding negative tiles lack the owned-target rectangle and central owned-target silhouette. The 0.5 cm/px negative tile is essentially uniform blue water; it was retained and inspected.
Other demonstration animals remain unlabelled background, including an animal clipped at the bottom left of the 1 cm/px pair and several animals in the 2, 3 and 4 cm/px pairs.
These observations assess this contact-sheet presentation only. They do not certify species realism, biological pose, optical/refraction correctness, or exact visible outlines.
